title: The Blush and Sage Cozy New Year's Eve at Home
description: A cozy New Year's Eve at home from Amazon: fluffy pink fleece pajamas, a sage green bubble faux fur throw, pink stemless champagne flutes, a black and gold Happy New Year sign, a Warm and Cozy candle and a pink microwave popcorn popper.
intro: Confession: the last time I went out for New Year's Eve I spent forty minutes in a coat line and rang in the year next to a stranger's elbow. Never again. Now it's fuzzy pink pajamas, the sage throw, popcorn made in that little pink popper, and sparkling cider in glasses that make it feel fancy anyway. The Happy New Year sign goes on the counter so it counts as decorating. Midnight from the couch. I'm not sorry.

sections.heading: The cozy part
paragraphs: A pink fluffy fleece pajama set with a cream sherpa collar, and a sage green bubble faux fur throw (50 x 60 in) that's thick enough to wear like a cape. That's the outfit. That's the plan.

sections.heading: The midnight toast
paragraphs: A set of 6 stemless champagne flutes that fade from clear to pink, 10 oz each, so sparkling cider and actual champagne both look cute. A black and gold Happy New Year metal sign on a wood base (11.8 x 6.5 in) does all the decorating.

sections.heading: The snacks and the glow
paragraphs: A collapsible pink silicone popcorn popper that goes straight in the microwave, no oil needed, and folds flat after. Light the Warm and Cozy candle (orange, cinnamon, clove and pine, gold lid) and you're done.
